title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Who Lost Her Wings
moral: When you help a friend, good things come back to you.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked into the flower meadow. Pink and yellow flowers grew everywhere. Little rabbits and butterflies played in the sun. Then {{NAME}} heard a tiny cry. A small fairy sat on a daisy. She looked very sad.

pages.content: The fairy's name was Pip. Her wings had fallen off in the wind. Without her wings, Pip could not fly. {{NAME}} looked at Pip's sad face. He felt very sorry for her.

pages.content: Pip's wings glowed and snapped right back on. She flew up, up, up into the sky. She laughed and did a little spin. When you help a friend, good things come back to you. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep tight. Pip said she knew a secret fairy door in the old oak tree. What could be inside?
